title.narrative: WWF-Norway: The Africa Bankable Nature Solutions (BNS) Fund

description.narrative: WWF-Norway will establish the Africa Bankable Nature Solutions Fund to demonstrate how high-quality blended finance, at scale, can provide part of the solution to addressing the finance gaps for climate adaptation, mitigation and biodiversity protection in Africa. Bankable Nature Solutions are commercially viable businesses that deliver measurable adaptation, mitigation and biodiversity benefits, and generate risk adjusted returns. The aim of the Africa Bankable Nature Solutions Fund is to catalyse investment into 14 businesses in Africa that directly support climate-vulnerable people to adapt to climate change, sustain jobs, and prove climate mitigation and biodiversity co-benefits, then scale and replicate. In tandem with WWF’s portfolio of complementary initiatives, the Africa BNS Fund will support the systems of climate finance in Africa to drive climate resilience, with rigorous attention to cross-cutting issues. WWF-Norway will partner with WWF-Netherlands and WWF Africa Offices to build on the successful track record, expert team and strong processes of the $440 million blended climate adaptation fund, the Dutch Fund for Climate and Development, ensuring quality and scale. Norfund will play an active advisory role. This proposal addresses Norad’s required information in the calls for proposals under Window 2: Ecosystem Adaptation and Innovative Finance, and grant scheme Sustainable job creation, business development and trade, and responds to the ‘specific guidance’ requested by Norad. Primarily Tanzania, Kenya and Madagascar, but open to Mozambique and Zambia.
